privacy_body:
Last updated: 5 March 2026

1. INTRODUCTION AND PURPOSE

Thank you for using the Kuafix mobile application (the "App"). This Privacy Policy (the "Policy") explains how your personal data is collected, used, shared, stored and protected when you use the Kuafix App developed by AnberTech. This Policy has been prepared in line with the applicable legislation, in particular the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK").

2. DEFINITIONS

  • Personal Data: Any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.
  • Special Categories of Personal Data: Special information such as race, ethnic origin, political opinion, religious belief, health or biometric data.
  • Data Subject: The natural person whose personal data is processed (app users).
  • Data Controller: AnberTech, the developer of the Kuafix app.
  • Data Processor: A person or organisation processing data on the controller's behalf (e.g. Firebase, Perfect Corp).

3. WHICH PERSONAL DATA DO WE COLLECT AND WHY?

3.1. Identity and Contact Information

First name, last name, phone number, province → Creating membership, authentication, account management, user communication and notifications.

3.2. Hairdresser / Business Information

Business name, address, working hours, days off and service settings → Creating the hairdresser profile and providing appointment planning and business management features.

3.3. Appointment Information

Appointment date, time, customer name, hairdresser details, selected services and notes added to the appointment → Creating, viewing and managing appointments and coordinating the service between users.

3.4. Images Added to Appointments

Reference hairstyle images, users' own photos and related notes that users add to their appointments → Clarifying expectations before the appointment and making visual communication between hairdresser and customer easier.

3.5. Device Data

Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) token and basic technical app identifiers → Sending notifications and keeping app functions running.

3.6. Preference and Usage Information

Notification settings, favourite hairdressers and some in-app preference settings → Personalising the user experience.

3.7. Photo / Image Data (AI Hair, Colour and Beard Try-On)

Photos uploaded by users and the AI outputs created from them ("Image Data") are processed to provide the hairstyle, hair colour, beard and similar visual try-on features. For this purpose, uploaded photos may be shared with Perfect Corp so that the AI processing service can be provided.

Important note: Photos showing a face may, depending on their nature, be subject to sensitive-data considerations. Kuafix does not use these images for authentication or to uniquely identify a person; it processes them only to create an AI-assisted visual try-on result at the user's request. This feature is always started explicitly by the user.

3.8. Archive Images (Photos Added from the Gallery)

Images that users add from their device gallery to the in-app archive → Storing and viewing them in the app, linking them to appointments and letting users manage their own image history.

3.9. Finance / Payment Records

Payment information that hairdressers mark per appointment, service amounts and per-customer finance records → Letting hairdressers track their income, view per-customer finance activity and manage internal business records.

4. HOW DO WE COLLECT PERSONAL DATA?

Data is collected directly from you (sign-up, profile, creating appointments, uploading photos, adding to the archive, marking finance fields), during your in-app actions and in some cases through automatic technical tools (e.g. the FCM token).

5. FOR WHAT PURPOSES DO WE PROCESS PERSONAL DATA?

  • Creating accounts and managing user sessions,
  • Running appointment processes,
  • Making hairdresser–customer communication easier,
  • Providing AI hair, colour and beard try-on services,
  • Running the archive and image storage features,
  • Letting hairdressers keep track of customer and payment records,
  • Sending notifications,
  • Improving the security, continuity and user experience of the app,
  • Meeting legal obligations.

6. WHO DO WE SHARE PERSONAL DATA WITH?

  • Developer / Data Controller: AnberTech
  • Service Providers (Data Processors):
    • Firebase (Google LLC): Authentication, database, file storage, notifications and app infrastructure.
    • Perfect Corp: Photo processing service for creating AI-assisted hairstyle, hair colour, beard and similar visual try-on results.
  • Between Users: Information shared between hairdresser and customer to the extent needed to run the appointment process.
  • Public Authorities: Where required by a legal obligation, an official request or legislation.

7. DATA RETENTION PERIODS

7.1. Account, Profile and General App Data

Account information, appointment records and other data needed to provide the app's functions are kept for as long as necessary to provide the service, manage the user account and meet legal obligations.

When you delete your account, your data is queued for deletion from our systems, with the aim of permanently deleting it within 7 days at the latest.

7.2. AI Try-On Input Photos

The original input photos you upload for an AI try-on are deleted within 24 hours (1 day) at the latest after processing is complete.

7.3. AI Try-On Result Images (Output)

Images created as a result of an AI try-on may be stored on Firebase so that you can view your results again, and are kept until you delete them.

7.4. Archive Images (Added from the Gallery)

Images that users add to the archive from their device gallery may be stored on Firebase for storage and viewing in the app, and are kept until the user deletes them.

7.5. Images Added to Appointments

Reference images, user photos and related visual content linked to appointments may be kept as part of the app's functions until the user or the related record is deleted.

7.6. Finance / Payment Records

Per-appointment payment records and customer finance records marked by hairdressers are kept within the related user account so that the finance tracking features of the hairdresser panel can work; when the account/profile is deleted, this data is also queued for deletion.

7.7. Profile / Account Deletion

When you delete your user profile or account, AI try-on results, archive images, images linked to appointments and other data related to your account are queued for deletion.

8. TRANSFER OF DATA ABROAD

Kuafix may use third-party service providers such as Firebase (Google LLC) and Perfect Corp in its service infrastructure. Your personal data may therefore be transferred abroad depending on the server locations of the infrastructure used. Such transfers are carried out in line with the legal requirements of the applicable legislation.

9. YOUR RIGHTS (UNDER KVKK)

Under the applicable legislation, you have the right to learn whether your personal data is processed, to request information if it has been processed, to learn the purpose of processing, to ask for it to be corrected if it is incomplete or inaccurate, to request its deletion or destruction, and to exercise the other rights granted by the legislation.

10. DATA SECURITY

Access controls, authorisation measures, secure infrastructure and reasonable technical and organisational measures are used to keep your data secure. Even so, no system that transfers data over the internet or stores it electronically can be guaranteed to be completely risk-free.

11. CHILDREN'S PRIVACY

Kuafix does not aim to knowingly collect personal data from children without the parental or guardian consent required by applicable law. If you suspect this has happened, please contact us.

12. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY

This Privacy Policy may be updated in line with app features, technical infrastructure or legal requirements. The updated version applies from the date it is published on this page.

13. CONTACT

For questions or requests about this Privacy Policy, or to exercise your data rights, you can contact us:
Email: destek.kuafix@gmail.com

Effective date: 5 March 2026

By downloading, accessing or using the Kuafix app, you accept the following Terms of Use. Please read these terms carefully before using the app. If you do not accept these terms, you should not use the app.

1. Scope of the Service

  • Kuafix is a mobile application developed to make creating and managing appointments, and communication, between hairdressers and customers easier.
  • The app may offer features such as appointment planning, adding images, leaving notes, AI-assisted hairstyle / hair colour / beard try-ons and per-customer finance tracking for hairdressers.
  • Kuafix reserves the right to change, update, improve, restrict or remove its features over time.

2. Account and User Responsibility

  • You may need to create a user account to use some features of the app.
  • Users must provide accurate, up-to-date and complete account information.
  • You are responsible for actions taken through your account, and for keeping your account secure.
  • Content that is false, misleading, unlawful or infringes the rights of third parties must not be shared.

3. Subscriptions, Free Trial and In-App Purchases

  • Kuafix may offer different paid subscriptions and in-app purchases depending on the user type.
  • Hairdresser subscriptions: 399 TL per month, 999 TL for 3 months.
  • Customer subscriptions: 23.99 TL per month, 63.99 TL for 3 months.
  • A 1-month free trial may be offered to everyone. At the end of the free trial, unless the user cancels, the subscription may continue as a paid subscription under the App Store rules.
  • Where paid subscriptions and in-app purchases are offered through the App Store, payments are charged to your Apple ID.
  • Unless cancelled, subscriptions may renew automatically under the rules of the relevant store.
  • You can manage or cancel your subscriptions and any automatic renewal in your Apple ID account settings.
  • The applicable pricing, free trial, promotion and billing terms are those shown on the purchase screen and in the App Store.

4. Credit System and AI Try-On Use

  • Kuafix may use a credit system for AI-assisted hairstyle, hair colour, beard and similar visual try-on features.
  • When the first trial is started, the user may be given 6 credits.
  • Active subscribers may receive 6 gift credits every week.
  • Each photo / style / hair / beard try-on uses 2 credits.
  • If the credit balance is not enough, the user can buy extra credits.
  • Extra credit packs:
  • • 6 credits: 12.99 TL
  • • 12 credits: 21.99 TL
  • • 18 credits: 29.99 TL
  • Credits are offered only for use within the app; they cannot be exchanged for cash, transferred to another account or refunded, except where required by law or mandatory consumer rights.
  • Kuafix reserves the right to change the rules for granting credits, the terms of use, the scope of promotions and the credit packs.

5. AI Features

  • Kuafix may offer AI-assisted hairstyle, hair colour, beard and similar visual try-ons based on photos uploaded by users.
  • These features are offered only as a visual preview and for user experience; real-life results may not be exactly the same.
  • AI outputs do not constitute a guarantee as to style, colour, facial fit or aesthetic result.
  • The user accepts that they consent, within the related privacy policy, to their uploaded photos being processed for this feature and shared with the necessary technical service providers.
  • Kuafix does not promise that AI results replace a professional hairdressing service.

6. Content Uploaded by Users

  • The user accepts that they have the right to use the photos, images, notes and similar content they upload to the app.
  • Uploading content that infringes the rights of others, is used without permission, or is unlawful, offensive, obscene, misleading or harmful is prohibited.
  • Content uploaded by users may be processed for appointment management, archiving, AI try-ons and providing the app's functions.
  • Kuafix reserves the right to remove content, restrict access or take action on the related accounts where it considers this necessary for the security of the app or for legal obligations.

7. Hairdresser Finance and Payment Records

  • Hairdresser users can mark or track fees collected per appointment and per-customer finance records in the app.
  • This feature is a recording and tracking tool offered only for the user's convenience.
  • Kuafix does not guarantee the accuracy of financial data entered by the user for accounting, tax, official records or legal declarations.
  • The user is responsible for the accuracy of the information entered in the finance/payment fields and for using it in line with the relevant legislation.

8. Account Deletion and Data Processing

  • You can delete your account at any time using the options provided in the app.
  • When account deletion is started, the data related to your profile is queued for deletion according to the processes described in our privacy policy.
  • Photos, AI outputs, archive images, appointment content and other related data may also be included in the deletion process if they are linked to the account.
  • For detailed information on how data is processed, stored and deleted, please see our Privacy Policy.

9. Prohibited Use

  • The app must be used only lawfully, honestly and for its intended purpose.
  • Reverse engineering the app, tampering with its source code, misusing its systems or trying to disrupt the service is prohibited.
  • Creating fake accounts, providing misleading information, acting on behalf of someone else or using the app for harmful purposes is prohibited.
  • No use that could harm the Kuafix infrastructure, other users or third-party systems is accepted.

10. Intellectual Property Rights

  • The Kuafix app, its design, software, brand elements, interfaces and original in-app content belong to AnberTech or the relevant right holders.
  • These terms of use give the user only a limited, non-transferable and revocable right to use the app for its intended purpose.
  • Copying, reproducing, distributing or commercially using Kuafix content without permission is prohibited.

11. Disclaimer of Warranties

  • Kuafix provides the app "as is" and "as available".
  • It is not guaranteed that the app will be uninterrupted, error-free, completely secure or always available.
  • No express or implied warranty of accuracy, completeness or fitness for a particular purpose is given for AI results, appointment processes, the credit system, finance records entered by users or user content.

12. Limitation of Liability

  • To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Kuafix and AnberTech cannot be held liable for direct or indirect damages arising from the use of or inability to use the app, third-party services, user content, subscriptions, the credit system or AI outputs.
  • The user is responsible for consequences arising from incorrect data entry, wrong appointment information, uploading inappropriate photos, incorrect actions regarding credit use or use contrary to legislation.

13. Third-Party Services

  • Kuafix may use third-party service providers for some features to work.
  • The infrastructure provided by these service providers may be subject to their own technical terms and policies.
  • Kuafix may have no direct control over the availability or behaviour of the App Store, Firebase, AI service providers and similar third-party services.

14. Changes to and Termination of the Service

  • Kuafix may change, suspend or terminate all or part of the app, with or without prior notice.
  • Users' access to certain features may be affected by such changes.
  • In case of use contrary to the rules, misuse or a security risk, access to accounts may be restricted temporarily or permanently.

15. Changes to the Terms

  • These Terms of Use may be updated from time to time.
  • The current version applies from the moment it is published in the app, on the official website or on a suitable digital platform.
  • Continuing to use the app after the terms are updated means that you accept the current terms.

16. Contact and Support

  • For support, questions and reports, you can contact us at: destek.kuafix@gmail.com

By using the Kuafix app, you accept the Terms of Use above.
delete_body:
You can delete your account in the Kuafix app from within the app at any time. When your account deletion request is received, the data related to your account is queued for deletion.

After Deletion

  • Your profile information (first name, last name, phone number, province and related account information) is deleted.
  • All your appointment records and content related to appointments are deleted.
  • Images and notes you added to appointments are deleted.
  • Your AI try-on result images are deleted.
  • Images you added to the archive from your gallery are deleted.
  • Notification information for your device (e.g. the FCM token) is deleted.
  • For hairdresser accounts, per-customer finance / payment records are also deleted to the extent they are linked to the account.

About AI Try-On Photos

The original input photos uploaded for an AI try-on are deleted within 24 hours (1 day) at the latest after processing is complete, without waiting for account deletion.

Deletion Period

When account deletion is started, your data is queued for removal from active systems. For technical reasons, some records may be kept for up to 7 more days for backup or system continuity, with the aim of permanently deleting them at the end of this period.

Important Note

Certain data may be kept separately, only to the extent and for as long as necessary, because of legal obligations, dispute resolution, fraud prevention or requirements of applicable legislation.

For more information on how your personal data is processed, please see our Privacy Policy.

If you have any questions, you can contact us: destek.kuafix@gmail.com
